title: Versailles ~$28 vs the Forbidden City ~$6 in Winter | China Travel Expert
description:
Winter is low season at both palaces — and the gap is wild. The Palace of Versailles Passport (full estate) is €25 for non-EEA visitors from November to March; that's about $28 at today's rate. The Forbidden City in Beijing drops to its off-season price of ¥40 from November 1 — about $6. Same winter week, and Beijing's imperial palace costs more than four times less to walk into.

The Forbidden City covers 72 hectares and is the largest palace complex on earth, so you are not trading size for the lower price — you are getting the bigger site for a fraction of the cost.

🧭 Expert Tip: Forbidden City tickets are sold online only and release 7 days ahead — none are sold at the gate, so book before you fly.

凡尔赛宫冬季护照票（非欧盟）€25，约 $28；故宫 11 月起淡季 ¥40，约 $6——同一个冬天，差四倍多。
